capability: Change one thing, measure, keep or undo
title: One change, then measure.

hook.picture: Close on a line with six kinks; the whale shoves all six flat at once; one pod answers ✓ and another ✕ (raw sienna chip).
hook.words: I changed six things at once.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I changed six things. Now I don't know what helped.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three-times device: three bundled laps, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½; pods flip between ✓ and ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Big bundles hide what really worked.

stakes.body: Gains can't be explained or repeated, and a harmful change hides inside a helpful bundle.

solution_hint: Change one thing. Measure. Keep or undo.

metaphor.body: The whale smooths exactly one kink per lap; a ring measures; the counter rises (keep, a tick lands) or falls (the line springs back).

steps.picture: The whale smooths exactly one kink; a ring pulses; the counter beside it moves up.
Push-in: up, so a tick lands (kept). Next kink: the counter drops, and the line springs back (undone).
steps.words: Better? Keep it. Worse? Undo it.
steps.sound: note up a step; next note drops back

steps.picture: The tick strip shows each change with its reading, kept or undone.
steps.words: Each change written down with its score.

steps.picture: The ring is the same size every lap.
steps.words: The measure never changes between tries.

real_case.claim: A self-training setup in Manu's Motion Atlas: freeze the grader, baseline 3 tasks x 3 attempts, try 3 single-change candidates, keep or revert, confirm on held-out tasks.

source.title: My Self Training Claude Code Setup (Motion Atlas source)

honest_limit.picture: A kept change wins on the three familiar pods; a fresh fourth pod answers ✕. The gain did not travel.
honest_limit.words: It won on three tasks. Not the fourth.

not_this.body: One small win is not a general win.

ending_pattern.body: FELT close shot of the six-kink line: kinks smooth one per beat, each ringed and ticked; one springs back; both pods answer ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT all six kinks were shoved at once and results were mixed; the same line is now smoothed one kink per beat, each measured.

end_belief.body: Change one thing. Measure it. Keep what wins.
